prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high carbohydrate loading for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals/snacks distributed throughout the day
Emphasizes high carbohydrate intake (60-70% of calories) suitable for marathon training
All meals are vegetarian with no meat, poultry, or fish
Provides approximately 3000-3500 calories appropriate for a 68kg endurance athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading, with specific performance goals and dietary restrictions (vegetarian)
